gates.description: All automated gates must pass (tests, scans, compliance checks)
Rollback plan must be documented and tested
Release notes must be complete and reviewed
Go/no-go decision must be documented with rationale
No open P0 or P1 bugs targeted to this release
Progressive rollout strategy must be defined (canary → partial → full)

anti_patterns.description: Every release is a drama — engineers work late, things break, hotfixes fly
A wiki page with 47 manual steps — someone always forgets step 23
Tested in dev and deployed to production — staging is bypassed consistently
Feature flags used for release but never cleaned up — codebase becomes a maze of conditional logic
Strict cadence ships on schedule regardless of quality — it's Tuesday, we ship

escalation_triggers: Quality gates fail and there is pressure to override them for a business deadline
Release caused a production incident requiring rollback
Cross-team dependency conflict that teams can't resolve
Database migration required that isn't backward-compatible and needs coordinated downtime
Release process consistently taking longer than expected, indicating systemic issues
Compliance or regulatory requirement changes the release process

input_requirements.description: Spec.md with release scope and acceptance criteria

output_certifications: All automated gates pass (tests, scans, compliance checks)
No open P0/P1 bugs in this release
Progressive rollout strategy defined (canary → partial → full)
